g.title: TD_QSP
g.text: D2 blockade → postsynaptic supersensitivity → oxidative injury → structural plasticity latch · VMAT2 vesicular transport · basal ganglia direct/indirect pathways · drug PK/PD

(20 clusters · 200 nodes · 272 edges) — core structure: the separation of reversible receptor upregulation (RUP, τ≈300 d) from quasi-irreversible structural damage (SDAM, bistable) = the 'reversibility window'
The two therapeutic levers sit on opposite sides of the same synapse: D2 blockade↓(reduce the offending drug) vs dopamine supply↓(VMAT2 inhibition)
